project.title: Standardised Accounting and Inventory Process for Moving Services
project.objective: Design and roll out a standard process to link moving jobs with accurate bookkeeping and basic inventory tracking for a small moving services unit.
deliverables: Documented end-to-end process from booking a move to final invoice and posting
Standard chart of accounts and tax-compliant posting rules for moving services
Templates for sales invoices, quotes, and basic job cost summaries
Simple inventory and tools tracking procedure for movers
Training session and quick-reference guides for bookkeepers and movers
constraints: Must comply with tax legislation and bookkeeping regulations for service companies
Process must be usable by movers with minimal admin time on-site
All tools must be trackable without new paid software
Solution must be auditable and align with company policies and commercial law
Initial rollout must be ready for pilot within 21 days

risks.risk: Movers do not consistently follow new packing and inventory recording steps.
risks.mitigation: Create very simple checklists, provide short training, and gather early feedback to simplify steps.

risks.risk: Incorrect tax treatment of moving services on invoices.
risks.mitigation: Bookkeepers validate tax rules with tax advisor and document clear VAT/tax codes in guidelines.

risks.risk: Process adds too much admin work for bookkeepers during peak periods.
risks.mitigation: Automate repetitive entries via templates and batch posting rules; pilot with limited volume first.

risks.risk: Data from movers (weights, items, hours) is incomplete or inaccurate.
risks.mitigation: Define minimum mandatory fields and add validation checks in job sheets before invoicing.

themes.why_relevant: Need a clean handover from movers to bookkeepers so every job is invoiced and posted correctly.

themes.theme: Compliance with tax and bookkeeping regulations
themes.why_relevant: Moving services must be invoiced and recorded in line with statutory obligations and tax law.
Movers have limited time; forms and checklists must be quick and intuitive to use on-site.
Bookkeepers must quickly spot and fix accounting and data errors from job records.
Both movers and bookkeepers need clear guidance and short training to adopt the new process.

backlog.task: Map current workflow from move booking to invoice and ledger posting
definition_of_done: All current steps documented for at least 5 recent moves
Pain points and gaps between movers and bookkeepers listed
Reviewed with one mover and one bookkeeper for accuracy

backlog.task: Design standard job sheet for movers including inventory and time data
definition_of_done: Job sheet template created with required fields for items, hours, distance
Fields validated by at least one bookkeeper for accounting needs
Pilot version tested on 2 moves and feedback captured

backlog.task: Create standard chart of accounts and posting rules for moving services
definition_of_done: List of relevant accounts for moving revenue, costs, and tools agreed
Posting rules for typical transactions documented
Tax codes and VAT treatment defined and checked against legislation

backlog.task: Develop invoice and quote templates for moving jobs
definition_of_done: Invoice template includes mandatory legal fields and tax details
Quote template aligned with final invoice structure
Templates tested with 3 sample jobs and totals reconciled

backlog.task: Define simple tools and equipment tracking procedure for movers
definition_of_done: Checklist for tools before and after each job created
Procedure fits within existing loading/unloading routine
At least 2 movers confirm it is practical to use daily

backlog.task: Draft accounting and compliance guideline for the new process
definition_of_done: Guideline covers invoicing, posting, and document retention
References relevant tax and commercial law requirements
Reviewed by accounting manager or equivalent role

backlog.task: Run joint training session for movers and bookkeepers
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials prepared
At least one session delivered with both roles present
Attendance and key questions documented for follow-up

backlog.task: Pilot the new process on a limited set of moving jobs
definition_of_done: At least 5 moves processed using new job sheets and templates
All related invoices issued and posted using new rules
List of issues and improvement ideas compiled

backlog.task: Set up error log and correction workflow for accounting issues
definition_of_done: Simple log format for errors and corrections created
Process for reporting and resolving errors agreed with movers
First 10 logged issues show status and resolution steps

backlog.task: Refine process and templates based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback from movers and bookkeepers consolidated
At least 3 concrete improvements applied to templates or steps
Updated versions shared and version-controlled

backlog.task: Create quick-reference one-pagers for movers and bookkeepers
definition_of_done: One-pager for movers with key steps and do's/don'ts created
One-pager for bookkeepers with posting rules summary created
Both documents validated against full guideline

backlog.task: Agree go-live date and support plan for wider rollout
definition_of_done: Go-live date confirmed with operations and accounting
Support contact and escalation path defined
Plan for first 2 weeks of monitoring documented

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current workflow and define target process scope
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking for everyone to share how moves currently flow into invoices and postings.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the start and end points of the new standard process.
Confirm which data from movers is mandatory for accounting.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalise the standard moving job sheet for movers
threads_plan.trigger: Mover shares first draft of the job sheet and asks for accounting input.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the fields and layout of the standard job sheet template.
Decide how movers will capture and submit job sheets (photo, scan, or paper drop-off).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on posting rules, tax treatment, and invoice templates
threads_plan.trigger: Bookkeeper posts draft posting rules and invoice/quote templates for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the chart of accounts and posting rules for moving services.
Approve the invoice and quote templates for pilot use.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and coordinate the pilot and training sessions
threads_plan.trigger: Message proposing pilot scope, candidate jobs, and training dates.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which moves will be included in the pilot and the pilot start date.
Agree on training format and who must attend before pilot starts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Monitor pilot progress, log issues, and refine the process
threads_plan.trigger: First pilot jobs completed and initial issues or errors reported in the channel.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in during pilot with blockers and key numbers of jobs processed
Weekly summary post with main issues, decisions, and next steps
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and process tweaks
On-demand mini-review whenever a new template or guideline version is proposed
